verdict.rationale: The only affirmative evidence of data export is a downloadable PDF of the round-modeling analysis, which is a narrow, document-style export. It does not show a bulk export of all cap-table data in machine-readable open formats. The cap-table report-download items appear only as question-form support article titles, which do not establish capability. The migration evidence is inbound only (moving into Eqvista), not leaving. Missing for 10: documented full-account export of all data, open machine-readable formats (CSV/JSON), affirmative documentation of cap-table report exports, an offboarding/exit path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: you can get a downloadable PDF file of the analysis that can be easily shared to all important stakeholders of your company
